name: Classic
credit: Design by Dave Shea, with modifications by Matt Mullenweg. Announced in version 0.72 and named “Classic” when themes arrived in 1.5.[^wp072][^wp15]
about: Reconstruction from the theme’s stylesheet: the sage header, the italic Times title and the dotted rules are as written there. The header green is darkened a little for legibility, and Lucida Grande falls back to your system’s sans-serif.

name: Kubrick
credit: Designed and built by Michael Heilemann, and adapted for WordPress by Matt Mullenweg and Ryan Boren. The default theme from 1.5 to 2.9.[^wp15][^heilemann]
about: Reconstruction. The original’s blue header and grey footer were image files; here they are drawn as gradients.

name: Twenty Ten
credit: No single designer is named; the first commit thanks “Ian Stewart, Matt Thomas, and others.”[^twentyten-commit] The first new default in five years.[^wp30]
about: Reconstruction. Georgia and Helvetica are the theme’s own choices. Its header was a photograph of a tree-lined lane, replaced here by a drawn landscape.

name: Twenty Thirteen
credit: Design by Joen Asmussen; development by Konstantin Obenland and Lance Willett.[^twentythirteen-intro]
about: Reconstruction. The original’s typefaces, Bitter and Source Sans Pro, are approximated by fonts on your device, and the header circles are redrawn.

name: Twenty Nineteen
credit: Led by Allan Cole, with Kjell Reigstad as design coach. It arrived with the block editor.[^twentynineteen-intro][^wp50]
about: Reconstruction, and a close one: the original also used the fonts already on the reader’s device, a serif for text and a sans-serif for headings.

name: Twenty Twenty-One
credit: Design lead Mel Choyce-Dwan; development lead Carolina Nymark.[^wp56]
about: Reconstruction. The pastel green and the system font stack are the theme’s own.

name: Twenty Twenty-Two
credit: Design by Kjell Reigstad; development led by Jeff Ong. The first default block theme.[^twentytwentytwo-intro][^wp59]
about: Reconstruction. Source Serif is approximated by a serif on your device, and the original’s bird illustrations are not redrawn.

name: Twenty Twenty-Five
credit: Design lead Beatriz Fialho; development leads Carolina Nymark and Juan Aldasoro.[^twentytwentyfive-intro]
about: Reconstruction. The original’s typeface, Manrope, is approximated by your system’s sans-serif.
